from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company whose report this belongs to")
    report_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024 Q1)")
    account_name: str = Field(description="The name of the account/line item (e.g., Other Payables)")
    balance_type: str = Field(description="The time point of the balance (e.g., Ending, Beginning)")
    amount: str = Field(description="The exact numerical value as written in the document")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., CNY, USD)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
